bullets.text: AI-Driven Threat Insights - **Microsoft** unveils an AI-assisted workflow to enhance threat detection efficiency and accuracy.
Secure AI Adoption Insights - The 2026 **Microsoft Data Security Index** highlights critical priorities for safeguarding data amid AI growth.
Windows 11 Insider Updates - New builds released for **Windows 11** Insiders, featuring various improvements and fixes.
Frontier Transformation Unveiled - **Microsoft** introduces a new approach to align AI with human ambition for business growth.
Celebrating Security Excellence - **Microsoft** announces winners of the 2026 Security Excellence Awards, highlighting collaborative cybersecurity efforts.
AI Inference Breakthrough - **Microsoft** launches the Maia 200, an advanced AI accelerator designed for efficient inference.
Government Data Security Strategies - **Microsoft** emphasizes proactive measures to safeguard governmental data against evolving cyber threats.
Enhancing GitHub Copilot - New SDK enables **GitHub Copilot** to integrate work context, improving developer productivity.
Securing AI Agents - **Microsoft** discusses the importance of runtime protection for AI agents to mitigate security risks.
